data.body: `yaml.load(handle.read())` is called without a `Loader`. On PyYAML 5.1–5.3 this silently falls back to a broad loader (deprecation warning, still able to construct arbitrary Python objects for certain tags); on PyYAML 5.4+/6.x the `Loader` argument is required and this call raises `TypeError: load() missing 1 required positional argument: 'Loader'`, so the function cannot succeed with current PyYAML versions. Use `yaml.safe_load`, which also accepts the file handle directly.
